Mana Method, Flame Rune: a rune array of fire forms before you; after a breath a bolt of flame leaves it and GROWS as it flies, wider and harder the further it goes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Late-game: the Mana Zone gate applies.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_water: Mana Method, Water Rune: a rune array of water forms before you; the bolt that leaves it PURSUES the foe nearest your line of fire, turning toward it as it flies. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Late-game: the Mana Zone gate applies.
Mana Method, Wind Rune: a rune array of wind forms before you; the gale that leaves it PURSUES the foe nearest your line of fire and lifts what it strikes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Late-game: the Mana Zone gate applies.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_earth: Mana Method, Earth Rune: a rune array of earth forms before you; the stone that leaves it GROWS as it flies and slows what it strikes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Late-game: the Mana Zone gate applies.
Mana Method, True Magic: a rune array that makes the REAL element of your natural attribute. The bolt ignores magic resistance, devils are highly susceptible, and where it lands it leaves real blocks for a while (water sources, a stone mound, fire, moss) where you may build. Needs Stage 3 control and a natural attribute; the environment's dense mana pays part of the cost.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_air_s: Mana Method, Air Step Rune: a small rune array forms under your feet and holds you up. Walk on air for a few seconds; sneak to drop. Works for any mage with the Mana Zone gate. Late-game: the Mana Zone gate applies.
Mana Method, Dash Rune: a rune array bursts behind you and throws you forward in your look direction, with a short grace for the fall. Short cooldown. Late-game: the Mana Zone gate applies.
nusmp.mana_method.air_step: Air Step Rune: walk on air for %s s (sneak to drop)
